target_customer: Software vendors and enterprises that answer customer security, privacy and compliance questionnaires, RFPs and DDQs
problem: Sales and security teams lose many hours answering repeated security questionnaires that slow deals.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription, pricing not public

founders.name: Louis Mutricy
founders.background_notes: Listed on the YC page; no background found in sources opened.

founders.name: Gaspard de Lacroix
founders.background_notes: Listed on the YC page; no background found in sources opened.

technical_complexity.rationale: In 2020 the product matched questions to prior answers and documents, which is standard text matching; large language models later changed this.

defensibility.rationale: Answer libraries and integrations create some lock in but the workflow was easy to copy, and many rivals appeared.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Current rivals named on Skypher's own blog include SafeBase, Conveyor, Wolfia and Qvidian; third parties also list Vanta and Loopio. Entry dates were not established.

market_need_then: Customer security reviews were a recurring burden for SaaS vendors selling to enterprises; no dated source for 2019 or 2020 demand was opened.

branding.domain_note: Uses skypher.co, not .com; no history found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Performance claims: 10x faster, 96% accuracy; marketing heavy

brand_strength.rationale: No press, community or brand story found; name resembles cypher or sky related words and a search for it returned unrelated brands.

pivots.to: Agentic AI for security portals and questionnaires
pivots.why: Company site now describes an AI agent platform; date and reason not stated

outcome_analysis: Skypher is active and claims over 200 customers including Adobe, Deel and Retool, with offices in Paris and the US. Public funding is only about $1M of seed money in 2021, so growth looks capital efficient or data is missing. The generative AI wave is a tailwind but also brought crowded competition. No acquisition or shutdown was found.
notes: Funding is aggregator only: SeedTable lists a $850k round in January 2021 and a $130k round in March 2020; CB Insights lists $0.85M in February 2021 from Bpifrance, Kima Ventures and angels, calling it Seed. The label conflicts so stage is other. PitchBook also names Agoranov, F3A Ventures and Y Combinator as investors and totals $998K; the $130k March 2020 round is single source and unverified. BounceWatch gives a founding year of 2022, which conflicts with the YC page. Customer and 200+ count are company claims. No company or press source found for founder backgrounds. No dated competitor sources near the 2020 batch were found.
